summary: Title Update 1.007 (Sept 30) is mostly Franchise salary-cap and CPU roster fixes plus catch-from-sack and run-action blocking tuning; 1.006 (Sept 16) extended downfield pass lead and tuned jostle / man press. Cover 4 Quarters (with match checks) is the community base defense vs the vertical and return-route meta, DB Fire 2 is the preferred pressure over Cover 0, and Cover 6 is called the strongest run fit. On offense the Buccaneers Gun Doubles Clamp Stack (Texas Y-Stutter Wheel vs man, Motion Shuffle Vert Smash vs Cover 3, Return Bench vs Cover 2) and the Jets Empty Motion Mesh Rail lead.

notes: Dynamic Salary Cap and CPU roster management fixes in Franchise
WR catch success tuned on throws out of sack situations
Fixed field goal blocking with looping defenders
Game clock fix after delay of game

findings.claim: Sept 30 update 1.007 fixes Dynamic Salary Cap and CPU signing/trade logic in Franchise, tunes WR catches from sack situations, and improves run-action block targeting.
Sept 16 update extended default pass lead on downfield throws, tuned WR acceleration out of jostle wins, and increased the Man Press penalty for shading the wrong way.

Cover 4 Quarters is the community go-to vs the vertical-heavy meta; Match Coverage Checks on Cover 3 Match, Quarters, Palms and Cover 6 are the cleanest counter to return routes and floods; DB Fire 2 beats Cover 0 vs return-route offenses.
To stop Four Verticals play two-high (Cover 4, Cover 2, Tampa 2), user the deep middle and use Overtop leverage; never sit in Cover 1 / Cover 3.
Vs runs: Cover 4 Quarters / Palms for inside runs, OLB Fire 2 for outside runs with lead blockers, Cover 6 as the strongest overall run defense; Texas 4-Man stunt vs inside runs.
4-3 Even 6-1 Cover 4 Quarters and Dime 2-3 Odd DB Fire 2 are standout meta defensive calls.
Buccaneers Gun Doubles Clamp Stack: Texas Y-Stutter Wheel vs man, Motion Shuffle Vert Smash vs Cover 3, Return Bench vs Cover 2.
Jets Empty Motion Mesh Rail's motion HB wheel beats man deep; Gun Empty Ace adds QB Zone, Return Trail Go, Stick and Curls HB Post.
Beat Cover 4 with flats, RB routes, flood reads and runs when safeties bail; beat Cover 3 with flats, curls, seams and floods.
